Please direct all specific study related questions to the principal investigator of the study. You can find their contact information on the informed consent page of the study. If you would like to file a complaint about any study, please reach out to the institutional review board listed on the study informed consent.

All studies on this page are approved and managed by the Faculty Research Ethics Committee (FREC) and University Research Ethics Committee (UREC) at Wrexham University.

If you are a participant at Wrexham University and participating in a Research Module study, please direct all existing questions to the appropriate module leader.

# Home Research - Wrexham University

Here you will find all relevant PhD and Psychology Faculty member's research. All home studies currently for the BSc and MSc are managed on the **Psychology Technician Moodle webpage**. Please contact the [Psychology Technicians](mailto:psychology.technician@wrexham.ac.uk) at Wrexham University to publish your study on that Moodle page.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  document.querySelectorAll('.study-status').forEach(badge => {
    const endDate = badge.getAttribute('data-end-date');
    if (!endDate || today > endDate) {
      badge.textContent = 'Closed';
      badge.classList.add('bg-secondary');
    } else {
      badge.textContent = 'Active';
      badge.classList.add('bg-success');
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.study-btn').forEach(btn => {
    const endDate = btn.getAttribute('data-end-date');
    if (!endDate || today > endDate) {
      btn.classList.add('disabled');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
      btn.removeAttribute('href');
      btn.innerHTML = 'Study Closed';
    }
  });
});
</script>
